_comment: Capability -> MCP tool map for clarity-network. First run: discover once, write the names back here, then bind directly on every later run. Kondo names are verified against a live account; Loxo names are unresolved because no workspace this skill has run in has Loxo connected at all.
rate_limit: Kondo's LinkedIn-backed tools (load_chat, list_connections, set_chat_archived, set_chat_label, set_chat_reminder) allow ONE call every 2 seconds and must be sequential — parallel calls fail with -32000. load_chat takes one thread per call, so a 30-thread shortlist costs ~90s. list_inbox and read_chat are local and unrestricted.
resolution_rule: Name present -> call it directly, no discovery. Name null -> discover among connected MCPs, use it, write it back. required:true unresolvable -> STOP and name the missing capability. Never substitute a broader tool.

kondo_list_chats.purpose: keyword search across threads. NOT the list-building tool — use kondo_list_inbox for that.
kondo_list_chats.verified: 2026-09-01 — works for phrase search, unreliable for names
kondo_list_chats.note: NAME MATCHING IS BROKEN. Searching a person's full name returns matchType:'text' hits that do not contain the name at all, and linkedin:true returned nothing for a person whose thread was position 1 of list_inbox. Never conclude 'no thread exists' from a miss here, and never present its results as matches for the name asked for. Search a distinctive phrase instead, or page list_inbox and match on threadParticipantUrns.

kondo_read_chat.purpose: message history for threads ALREADY held locally by Kondo. Batches — takes an array of threads in one call.
kondo_read_chat.note: NOT sufficient on its own. Returns participants but an EMPTY messages array for any thread not recently opened in Kondo. Always call kondo_load_chat on the thread first. See Phase 2.

kondo_load_chat.purpose: fetch a thread's history from LinkedIn so read_chat can then return it
kondo_load_chat.verified: 2026-09-01 — a thread that read_chat reported as empty returned 12 messages after load_chat
kondo_load_chat.note: Two-step and one thread per call: load_chat returns only a message COUNT, never the messages. Must be followed by read_chat. Expensive — it paginates the LinkedIn API — so call it only for threads inside the Phase 5 shortlist, never for the whole window.

browser_navigate.purpose: open https://app.trykondo.com/settings/mcp during the Phase -2 preflight when Kondo is unreachable, so the recruiter sees connection state and a Kondo tab is open
browser_navigate.verified: 2026-09-01 — opened the page and returned the tab id; page shows a live status line and an Authorized applications list
browser_navigate.note: Optional: absent in most recruiter workspaces, in which case Phase -2 gives the URL as text instead. Do NOT close the tab afterwards — browser tools that clean up their own tabs will close the one the sweep needs.

kondo_list_inbox.purpose: the thread list. view:'AWAITING_REPLY' + before:<cutoff ms> IS the Phase 3 query, computed server-side.
kondo_list_inbox.note: AWAITING_REPLY = I sent last, waiting for them. NEEDS_MY_REPLY is the inverse and is NOT what this skill wants (see ranking.md on inbound pitches).

kondo_set_draft.purpose: write a prepared reply into a thread — DOES NOT SEND
kondo_set_draft.note: Approval-gated, interactive runs only. Kondo exposes no send tool at all.

kondo_list_connections.purpose: connection graph — OFF by default, James stood this down on 4 Aug

loxo_find_person.purpose: resolve a person by linkedin_url first (77.5% coverage), then name + company
loxo_find_person.note: Server registered as `loxo` at https://app.loxo.co/api/clarity-r2r/mcp. Data-tool names have never been observed — clarity-frontsheet guesses people_index / people_show but that is a GUESS. James's workspace exposes the real names.

loxo_person_notes.purpose: call notes and activity — history and the booked-call backtrack

loxo_company_activity.purpose: company notes — placements, terms, interviews. Drives the existing-client guard.
loxo_company_activity.note: Without this the client guard is SILENTLY disabled and the output still looks complete. Never run the sweep without it — say it is missing.

loxo_add_note.purpose: append a LinkedIn activity note. The only write this skill makes.
loxo_add_note.note: Must append a note and nothing else. If the only available Loxo write also attaches to jobs or changes status, STOP and ask — do not use the broader tool and simply omit fields.

notion_fetch_page.purpose: fetch the two pinned pages in notion-sources.json
notion_fetch_page.usage: pass page_id as `id`. If unavailable, fall back to reference/ranking.md and say so.
